Musk at We, Robot said Optimus could cost $20,000 to $30,000 (target)

faq.a: No. Optimus is not for sale and Tesla has no preorder. Musk said at Davos in January 2026 that Tesla could start shipping its first commercial Optimus robots by 2027.

faq.q: How much will Tesla Optimus cost?
faq.a: Musk has said that at scale Optimus would cost $20,000 to $30,000. This is a target, not a list price.
On the Q1 2026 earnings call Musk said Optimus production would begin at Fremont in late July or August 2026, with slow initial output, and a second factory at Giga Texas around summer 2027.

faq.q: Has the Optimus price target changed?
faq.a: In 2022 Musk said Optimus would cost less than $20,000; since 2024 he has given a range of $20,000 to $30,000.

notes: All prices are Musk's targets for future mass production, not prices for Gen 2 or v2.5 units, which are internal R&D and factory robots. Tesla's timelines have slipped repeatedly.
